mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism and may increase valproic acid levels; valproic acid is also a CYP450 inhibitor that can increase erythromycin levels, with potential for increased GI adverse effects and arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor valproic acid and erythromycin serum concentrations; consider alternative antibiotic; assess for increased valproic acid toxicity (tremor, ataxia) and erythromycin adverse effects (nausea, QT prolongation).
